text.en:
The President of the Philippines is authorized to receive and accept donations of money, not
subject to any onerous condition, made for the purpose of the national defense or support of the Philippine
Army. Said donations, once accepted, shall be irrevocable. The President is also authorized to prescribe the
rules and regulations under which the donated money may lie expended by the Philippine Army, without
affecting in any way its yearly appropriation. Donations made for a specific purpose shall be expended or used
only for that purpose.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, September 22, 1936.
